definition: to announce something officially in public
description: In an animated old town, a woman steps onto a stone balcony, unrolls a scroll and loudly declares to the gathered crowd that the new bridge is open; a bell ringer pulls the tower bell and the townspeople cheer and throw their hats in the air.
transcript: Hear this everyone! The new bridge is open!

en.question: What is happening on the balcony?

de.answer: Eine Frau verkündet der Menge etwas.
de.question: Was passiert auf dem Balkon?

es.answer: Una mujer está anunciando algo a la multitud.
phrases: tirar de la cuerda de la campana
